title: New agents for legal professionals | Claude Cowork
format_note: One 25 s unbroken motion-graphics shot on a flat cream ground: three serif headlines, a logo carousel, a chip wheel, wordmark. No product screen.
one_thing: Claude plugs into the legal tools lawyers already use, via 12 practice-specific plugins.

transcript.voice_style: No speech. Whisper returned a single stray 'I'; treated as none.
transcript.script_shape: Three claims in sequence: where it works, what it connects to, how many plugins. Each is shown by an object after the line, then the wordmark.

structure.frame0: Full headline 'Claude works where lawyers work' already on screen, dark serif, centred on cream. Subject present from the first frame (f0001.jpg, strips/window-01-0s.jpg).
structure.first_3s: Headline holds about 2.4 s, then dissolves word by word left to right while the next headline starts to build (strips/window-02-2.375s.jpg).

beats.what: Headline 'Claude works where lawyers work' holds still.
Words fade out in order; 'Connected across your legal stack' builds word by word.
Headline slides left; a row of app logo tiles enters from the right and fills the row.
Logo tiles bob in a staggered wave and stream left; 15 or more distinct logos pass.
'With 12 plugins tailored to different practices' builds word by word.
Headline drifts up and fades; a vertical wheel of 12 practice chips scrolls through a blurred focus band.
Coral dot appears, grows into the asterisk mark, wordmark types in.
Claude logo holds still; music silent from 23.19 s.

hero_moment.what: Mid-stream of the logo carousel (f0007.jpg): about 14 tiles in a wavy row, the densest and most colourful frame of the film.

ending.what: Coral asterisk and 'Claude' wordmark centred, still from 21.8 s to the end (f0012.jpg, f0013.jpg).

rhythm.how_change_is_paced: One shot, a new composition every 4-7 s: headline, headline, logo row, headline, chip wheel, logo. Between those, motion is continuous slides and word-staggered fades, never a cut. 42 % of sampled intervals are static.

look.ground: Flat warm cream (about #E6E5D9), no gradient, no texture. Fully light; luma 224.
look.accent_use: Coral appears only in the dot and asterisk at 21-25 s; partner logos supply the other colour.
look.type: Serif headline (dark, tight tracking) for claims; clean grotesque for chips; serif wordmark. Sentence case, no all-caps, no italics.

good.observation: Frame 0 carries the full claim; the film opens on its thesis with no build-up.
One idea per beat: claim, integrations, plugin count, brand. Every composition holds one subject on a flat ground.
Word-by-word build and fade gives a headline change without any cut; the same device is used three times.
The claim 'with 12 plugins' is proved by exactly 12 chips on screen, so the number is checkable.
Logo tiles are real partner marks, so the integrations claim is shown rather than described.
Staggered vertical wave across a stationary row adds energy to an otherwise static frame without a cut.

weak.observation: No Claude product interface is shown; how the plugins work or what an agent does is never visible.
weak.evidence: product_ui none of real-ui-capture across 13 frames

weak.observation: Third headline gets about 1.1 s of full-opacity hold for 7 words before drifting away, short of the reading rule.
Music ends at 23.19 s while the logo holds to 25.24 s, and loudness is -17.1 LUFS, 3 LU under the -14 target.
Tile logos are small inside the 100 px tiles; most are marks only and would not read at phone width.

rule_candidates.rule: A film may carry its whole claim in one continuous shot: change the composition every 4-7 s through slides and word-staggered fades rather than cuts.
Exceptions to a 1.8-3.5 s cut cadence need a different change source: here a new composition every 4-7 s.
Headlines can sit at 7.5-8 % of frame height, centred, one line, 5-7 words, with no accent word; the brand mark is larger at about 11 %.
Show a count claim with that many objects: 'with 12 plugins' is followed by 12 chips so the viewer can count them.
rule_candidates.evidence: chips list at 15.5-21 s; copy line at 14.4 s

rule_candidates.rule: Build a headline word by word at about 0.04-0.08 s per word; hold it still at least 0.5 s plus 0.3 s a word (2.6 s for 7 words).
rule_candidates.evidence: strips/window-05-14.042s.jpg; hold of third line about 1.1 s

rule_candidates.rule: End on a still wordmark for at least 3 s and let the music reach its end before the hold finishes; do not leave audio silent under the last 2 s.
A hero moment can be a dense object field in motion rather than a UI: about 14 staggered tiles fill the row at the midpoint of the film.
Measure social loudness: this brand master sits at -17.1 LUFS and -4.3 dBTP, so a -14 LUFS target is stricter than the corpus.
